query:
SELECT tr_type, tr_description
                     FROM transaction_types
                    WHERE tr_type = $1::text
                      AND ($2::text IS NULL OR tr_type COLLATE "C" >= $2::text)
                      AND ($3::text IS NULL OR tr_description LIKE $3::text ESCAPE '')
                    ORDER BY tr_type COLLATE "C"
                    LIMIT $4
